markdown:
For the complete documentation index, see [llms.txt](https://help.lob.com/llms.txt). This page is also available as [Markdown](https://help.lob.com/print-and-mail/integrations/api-integrations.md).

If your team already uses any CDP, CRM, or marketing automation tool, consider adding a direct mail touch to your customer outreach sequences by integrating Lob into the following platforms. Use any of our external API integrations to easily leverage one of the most performative channels in marketing as part of your digital campaigns.

- [Adobe Marketo Engage](https://help.lob.com/print-and-mail/integrations/api-integrations/adobe-marketo-engage)

- [ActionIQ](https://help.lob.com/print-and-mail/integrations/api-integrations/action-iq)

- [Blueshift](https://help.lob.com/print-and-mail/integrations/api-integrations/blueshift)

- [Citrix Podio](https://podio.com/market/packs/138857-postcards-and-letters-with-lobcom)
